brief: Personal brand mark for a senior web engineer who ships accessible products with AI craft. Must work as a WebGL core, favicon, and nav mark on a dark blue/amber site.
criteria: Solid silhouette for 3D, reads at 16 px, one-colour, ownable J without a second glyph.

concepts.name: Period Core
concepts.idea: Solid disc with a geometric J cut as negative space — the core of the orbit.
rationale: Circular silhouette drops straight into the WebGL center
Evenodd cut keeps the mark one path and favicon-safe
Blue/amber mono variants match the site system

recommendation: Period Core — approved direction for the portfolio identity and WebGL core.
next_steps: Optional trademark search before wider commercial use
